fields.narrative_intro: *A gloating person and a slumped person discuss banning the term 'artificial intelligence' at an AI detox retreat.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
GLOATING PERSON: "The U.S. President says he will ban the term 'artificial intelligence.'"
fields.panel2:
[build]
SLUMPED PERSON: "Our banner currently says 'artificial intelligence detox retreat.'"
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
GLOATING PERSON: "Then we’ll replace the phrase with a tasteful blank."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: The welcome banner is now a pristine white rectangle; everyone stares at it.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
SLUMPED PERSON: "The blank is now the loudest thing on the property."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The pristine blank has expanded across the building, blocking the entrance; a tiny 'DETOX RETREAT' sign hangs underneath.]

narrative_summary: A proposed terminology ban turns an AI detox retreat’s missing sign text into its most conspicuous feature.
rationale: Candidate 4 turns the banned phrase into a strong, escalating visual gag: the supposedly neutral blank becomes conspicuous and physically obstructive. Its final image pays off the setup cleanly without overexplaining or introducing distracting wordplay.
story_title: US President says he will ban the term 'artificial intelligence'
hat_pair: foam 'DO NOT DISTURB' hotel door sign worn as a flat rectangular hat with a tiny hanger hook at the top
